def process(command: list[str], cwd: Path, timeout: float) -> dict:
    """Temporary files avoid pipe deadlocks; wait4 owns reaping this child."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as stdout, tempfile.TemporaryFile() as stderr:
        started_at_unix_ns = time.time_ns()
        start = time.perf_counter()
        child = subprocess.Popen(
            command, cwd=cwd, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True,
            env={**os.environ, "NO_COLOR": "1"},
        )
        spawn_returned_unix_ns = time.time_ns()
        timed_out = threading.Event()

        def kill() -> None:
            try:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                timed_out.set()
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass

        timer = threading.Timer(timeout, kill)
        timer.start()
        try:
            _, status, usage = os.wait4(child.pid, 0)
            # Python 3.8 on the reporting runner has wait4 but not the 3.9
            # waitstatus_to_exitcode helper. Preserve subprocess exit semantics.
            if os.WIFSIGNALED(status):
                child.returncode = -os.WTERMSIG(status)
            elif os.WIFEXITED(status):
                child.returncode = os.WEXITSTATUS(status)
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"Unexpected child wait status: {status}")
        finally:
            timer.cancel()
            timer.join()
        seconds = time.perf_counter() - start
        stdout.seek(0)
        stderr.seek(0)
        return {
            "pid": child.pid, "spawn_returned_unix_ns": spawn_returned_unix_ns,
            "started_at_unix_ns": started_at_unix_ns,
            "command": list(command),
            "wall_seconds": seconds,
            "user_seconds": usage.ru_utime,
            "system_seconds": usage.ru_stime,
            "peak_rss_bytes": usage.ru_maxrss * (1 if sys.platform == "darwin" else 1024),
            "exit_code": child.returncode,
            "timed_out": timed_out.is_set(),
            "stdout": stdout.read().decode(errors="replace"),
            "stderr": stderr.read().decode(errors="replace"),
        }

import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, time
r=pathlib.Path(pathlib.Path('/tmp/tsr-member-cost-refresh-path').read_text().strip())
repo=pathlib.Path('<repo>')
def hashes():
    return {str(p.relative_to(repo)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (repo/'xtask').rglob('*.rs')}
env={**os.environ,'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':str(r/'source/target'),'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS':'2','PATH':'/tmp/tsr-beads-1.3.1:'+os.environ['PATH']}
before=hashes(); rows=[]
for name, command in [('build',['rtk','proxy','cargo','build','--offline','--release','-p','xtask']),('anchors',[str(r/'source/target/release/xtask'),'anchors']),('sections',[str(r/'source/target/release/xtask'),'sections']),('issue-ids',[str(r/'source/target/release/xtask'),'issue-ids'])]:
    start=time.monotonic()
    with (r/('docs-'+name+'.stdout')).open('w') as out,(r/('docs-'+name+'.stderr')).open('w') as err:
        child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=repo,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=err)
        print(json.dumps({'check':name,'pid':child.pid}),flush=True)
        rc=child.wait()
    row={'check':name,'command':command,'pid':child.pid,'returncode':rc,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'stdout':(r/('docs-'+name+'.stdout')).read_text(),'stderr':(r/('docs-'+name+'.stderr')).read_text()}
    rows.append(row)
    (r/'documentation-checks-progress.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rows':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'check':name,'returncode':rc,'tail':row['stdout'][-700:]+row['stderr'][-500:]}),flush=True)
    if name=='build': assert rc==0
after=hashes(); assert before==after
record={'rows':rows,'xtask_source_hashes':before,'source_stable':True,'canonical_runtime_changed':False}
(r/'documentation-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
assert json.loads((r/'documentation-checks.json').read_text())==record
